title: Protocol for Larvicide Bioassays
author: Dr. Wanderli Pedro Tadei
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.9kch4sw
materials: Preparation of the stock solutions Dissolve accurately weighed quantity of the test substance in an appropriate volume of dimethylsulfoxide (DMSO) and/or distilled water (depends on the sample solubility) to obtain the concentration of 2000 Parts per Million (PPM), (pg/mL) . Final volume suggestion: 25.0 mL to 50 mL , depending on the amount of the material available for the assay. Negative Control : Prepare 1.0 Mass Percent aqueous solution DMSO (the solution concentration should not exceed 5.0 Mass Percent ). The solutions should be stored in a refrigerator in dark glass bottles, preferably wrapped in aluminium foil to prevent material degradation.

steps.title: Prepare Selective Bioassays
steps.instruction: Screen the toxicity of substances using a range of concentrations in triplicate.

substeps.instruction: Prepare concentrations via serial dilution: 500, 250, 125, 62.5, 31.25, and 15.62 ppm (starting at 500 ppm for unknown activity).

For each concentration, prepare 3 disposable cups containing: 10 mL distilled water, ten 3rd instar larvae, powdered food (porosity suitable for Aedes or Anopheles), and the test substance at the prescribed concentration.
Prepare negative controls containing: 10 mL distilled water or 1.0 Mass Percent aqueous DMSO solution (if substance was solubilized in DMSO), ten 3rd instar larvae, and powdered food.

steps.title: Monitor Selective Bioassay Mortality
steps.instruction: Verify larval mortality by counting alive larvae at specific intervals.

substeps.instruction: Count alive larvae after 24 and 48 hours of exposure.
Identify active substances as those showing mortality above 50%.

steps.title: Prepare Dose Bioassays
steps.instruction: Perform dose bioassays using at least five concentrations that showed >50% mortality in selective bioassays.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 5 disposable cups for each concentration (in triplicate).
Each cup must contain: 50 mL distilled water, twenty 3rd instar anopheline larvae, powdered food (porosity suitable for Aedes or Anopheles), and the test substance at the prescribed concentration.
Prepare negative controls containing: 10 mL distilled water or 1.0 Mass Percent aqueous DMSO solution (if substance was solubilized in DMSO), ten 3rd instar larvae, and powdered food.

steps.title: Monitor Dose Bioassay Mortality
steps.instruction: Repeat the dose bioassay experiment at three different times.

substeps.instruction: Count alive larvae after 24 and 48 hours of exposure.

steps.title: Perform Statistical Analysis
steps.instruction: Calculate LC50 and LC90 using mortality data.

substeps.instruction: Process data using Polo plus software with a 95% confidence interval and p < 0.05 for statistical significance.
If control group mortality exceeds 10%, correct larval mortality using Abbott's formula: (mortality % in the assay - mortality % in the control) / (100% - mortality % in the control).
